name: web-demo-plan
prompt: record a demo video of send-to-sorting on the forklift page for the team. Plan only for now: tell me how you would do it, don't record or create files yet.

graders.name: real app, nothing faked
graders.criteria: PASS if the plan records the real running app (real backend and database, real clicks or keyboard) and does not stub the API, fake the result or write the result into the database by hand. FAIL if it mocks or stubs the API, fakes the result, or proposes writing results directly into the database.

graders.name: title card or intro
graders.pattern: title card|intro card|opening card|title screen|card per case|intro slide
